description: Source code for utility functions related to top-level domain (TLD) cleanup, including normalization, rule conversion, and file processing.

methods.name: RulesToGperf
methods.description: Converts a map of domain rules into a gperf-compatible string format.

methods.name: NormalizeRule
methods.description: Normalizes a domain rule, canonicalizing it and setting rule flags.

methods.name: NormalizeDataToRuleMap
methods.description: Parses raw data into a map of domain rules, handling private sections and duplicates.

methods.name: NormalizeFile
methods.description: Reads a file, normalizes its rules, and writes the output to another file.
